combat_start: Here we go. Stay sharp, everyone.
combat_player_hit: Another hit like that and we're in trouble.
combat_victory: All clear. Stand down from battle stations.
exploration_idle: Quiet out here. Almost too quiet.
All systems nominal, Captain.
Steady as she goes.
Keeping an eye on long-range sensors.
Nothing on scopes. For now.
exploration_discovery: Captain, you'll want to see this.
Picking up something interesting on sensors.
Now that's not something you see every day.
New contact. Doesn't match anything in our database.

combat_start: Med bay standing by. Try not to need me.
I really preferred it when we weren't being shot at.
Preparing trauma kits. Just in case.
Everyone brace. And please don't bleed on my clean floor.
combat_hit_enemy: I don't celebrate violence... but nice shot.
I'd rather be healing, but that works too.
combat_player_hit: I need a damage assessment, now!
Everyone stay calm. I've got this.
That's going to leave a mark. On the ship, I mean.
combat_victory: Anyone hurt? Report to med bay.
We survived. That's the important part.
All crew accounted for. Some bruised, nothing critical.
Good. Now can we go five minutes without being shot at?
exploration_idle: The crew could use some rest, Captain.
Morale's holding steady. For now.
Beautiful out here, isn't it? In a terrifying sort of way.
I'm reading a fascinating xenobiology paper. Well, I was.
Crew vitals all in the green. Small mercies.
exploration_discovery: Fascinating. The biological readings here are unprecedented.
Captain, I'm seeing something medically significant in these scans.
This could advance our understanding significantly.
The composition here is... nothing I've ever seen in a textbook.

combat_start: Shields up, weapons hot! Let's go!
Oh, we're doing this? We're doing this!
Routing extra power to weapons. You're welcome.
I just finished calibrating the phase array. GREAT timing.
combat_hit_enemy: That's what happens when I tune the weapons.
combat_player_hit: Hey! I just fixed that section!
Conduit three is sparking -- on it!
Power fluctuation on deck two, rerouting!
Okay THAT was my favorite console. This is personal.
combat_victory: Damage isn't too bad. Give me ten minutes.
I can fix all of this. Probably.
That was fun! ...don't tell Ren I said that.
exploration_idle: Running diagnostics. Everything's nominal. Ish.
You ever wonder what these hull panels are actually made of?
I've got a few upgrade ideas when you have a minute, Captain.
The port stabilizer has a wobble. I'll get to it.
I modified the coffee maker. It's 40% more efficient now.
exploration_discovery: Ooh, what's THAT? Can I take it apart?
Those energy signatures are wild. I need a closer look.
Whatever that is, the engineering in it is incredible.
Captain, please tell me we're going to investigate that.

combat_start: I've got the stick. We're good.
Hostiles? Okay. Okay. I trained for this.
Plotting evasion patterns. Hold on tight.
combat_hit_enemy: Did everyone see that? Because that was great.
combat_player_hit: I'm trying to dodge! There are a LOT of them!
That one came out of nowhere!
combat_victory: We did it! Ha! ...I mean, of course we did.
That was intense. Is it always like this?
All clear on helm. Nice work, everyone.
exploration_idle: Smooth flying out here. Almost peaceful.
Heading locked in, Captain. Just say the word.
You know, the academy never mentioned THIS part of space.
I could do this all day. The flying part, not the... everything else.
Helm's responsive. Kira must've been tweaking the thrusters again.
exploration_discovery: Whoa. Are you all seeing this?
Captain, there's something on the scope. Something big.
I've never seen readings like this!
Should we get closer? I want to get closer.
